# SARIF schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the unmodified OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 plus Errata 01
JSON schema, downloaded from:

https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

SARIF tests validate reports against this local copy so CI needs no network access.
